implPrompt: Read .claude/ralph.md and follow the rules in that file. Implement GitHub issue #{issue} ("{title}") from milestone '{milestone}'. You are already on branch {branch}: work there, do not create or switch branches. When the work is done and all tests pass, commit it and close issue #{issue}. Do not open a pull request and do not start another issue.
reviewPrompt: Review the work of milestone '{milestone}'. The diff to review is the output of `git diff {range}` — the phase branch {branch} against the feature branch {featureBranch}. Read the PRD and phase plan under docs/ for the feature, then check the diff for correctness, architecture, security, performance and test coverage. For every blocking problem create one GitHub issue in milestone '{milestone}' describing the fix, then end your reply with a line containing only BLOCKED. If nothing is blocking, summarise your non-blocking observations in your reply and end it with a line containing only APPROVED. Do not commit, push, merge or open a pull request.
